name: gimex::fsh::ExtractRecord
notes: Lane MX. GimexFshDirectory_ExtractRecord (the original and ours alone over seeded and crafted inputs; return, outputs, every byte written, the allocator's log). Hooked at its RVA (src/hook/tables/GimexFshDecodeDirectory.cpp). Mutants (tools/mutate.py, filter GimexFshDirectory, src/gz/GimexFshDirectory.size.cpp): 16 over the 4 functions, 13 killed (one only after the copier's test drew records of size one and block-coded records with room to copy), 3 equivalent (`available <= size`: equal values assign themselves; a comment that held a number; the reader's chunk scan for platforms up to 20 instead of 19: platform 20 without a font head leaves the directory null, and the original then crashes in the face splitter, so the test cannot draw it).
